item.description: An attempted robbery at an Antioch grocery store early Friday set off a chain of events that stretched nearly two miles and ended in a police shooting, authorities said.The incident began around 5:15 a.m. at a FoodMaxx on Lone Tree Way, where a car rammed the store's front doors. item.title: Young woman gunned down in Antioch
item.description: A 20-year-old woman was shot and killed Thursday around 7:17 p.m. in the 2200 block of Sycamore Drive in Antioch, police said.

item.title: Arrest in Pleasanton mother, son killings: What we know
item.description: A San Jose man was arrested on suspicion of murder in the fatal shootings of a 67-year-old woman and her 28-year-old son inside their Pleasanton home, police said.
